title: Compose request
description: A request to compose a recipe into run specs. Give the recipe either by its name in the library or as a document; exactly one of the two. Composition is pure: it creates nothing and the same request always gives the same response.

recipe_name.description: The name of a recipe in the library: its file stem, as `list_recipes` returns it, for example `sensor_sweep_tahoe`.

recipe.description: A recipe document (`compose: compose/1`). The layers it names (scenario, engine profile, sensors) are read from the library.

compose.description: The composition rules the recipe is written for.

inline_sensor.description: If true, each run spec carries its sensor block in place instead of a reference to the sensor file by name and content hash. The run id is the same either way.

max_runs.description: The most runs the recipe may compose to; a sweep with more is a composition error. At most 32.
